implementation.expression: context.health_ratio + (0 if inputs.candidate.id == inputs.source.id or (inputs.candidate.definition_id == params.preferred_token_definition and 'ownership' in inputs.candidate.components and inputs.candidate.components.ownership.owner == inputs.source.id) else params.fallback_group_offset) if context.healing else inputs.distance

nodes.expression: {'accepted': False, 'amount': 0, 'allocations': [], 'events': []} if inputs.samples[0].value < params.probability else inputs.effect.settlement
